newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela Hotel Melia sold $34 mln at 5th auction.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Hotel Melia sold $34 mln at 5th auction.

text.p: Irish investment group International Alliance Resource has bought Venezuela's Hotel Melia for $34.06 million at the fifth auction of the unfinished luxury hotel and shopping complex, a Banco Industrial de Venezuela (BIV) official said on Friday.
State-owned BIV had inherited the property in November 1994 when its owner could no longer meet bank payments.
"The public auction took place on April 30 ... and the price paid was higher than the base price of $32.78 million," the official said.
Of four interested bidders, he said only two qualified for the auction but gave no other details.
Construction of the central Caracas hotel, planned to be one of the largest and most luxurious complexes in Latin America, began in 1987.
